summary: Dauch Corp (formerly American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce that its represented workforce (UAW Local 2093) at the Three Rivers Manufacturing Facility in Michigan ratified a new four-year collective bargaining agreement. The event is a routine labor contract approval, not a special situation. No financial terms, premium, or strategic change is provided. The filing includes a press release confirming the agreement and resumption of operations. No deal-related mechanics, board recommendations, or advisors are named. This is a standard operational update with no actionable special-situation angle.
